lines.zh: 我喷出一股水，身子往后射。
lines.en: I jet water and shoot backward.

lines.zh: 八条腕在身后拖着，像旗帜。
lines.en: Eight arms trail behind me like banners.

lines.zh: 我从冰层下的暗水穿过。
lines.en: I pass through black water under the ice.
A tentacle reaches out and grabs the current.

lines.zh: 我在沟底上方慢慢滑行。
lines.en: I drift along above the trench floor.

lines.zh: 巨影掠过珊瑚，鱼都散了。
lines.en: My huge shadow clears the reef of fish.
I turn sideways into a narrow gap.
Cold water slides along my mantle.
I row my arms and sink deeper.

lines.zh: 身体一缩一放，我往前冲。
lines.en: Contract, release — I surge forward.
My arm tips brush the ice shards.
I swim beneath a whale's song.
I crawl sideways along the rock wall.
The pressure flattens me thinner.

lines.zh: 我用腕足推了一下岩壁借力。
lines.en: I push off the rock wall with one arm.

lines.zh: 墨在身后散开，我趁黑走。
lines.en: Ink spreads behind me; I move in the dark.

lines.zh: 沟越来越窄，我把身体压扁。
lines.en: The trench narrows; I flatten myself.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转身，腕足缠上石柱。
lines.en: I turn slowly, arms wrapping a pillar.

lines.zh: 我悬在暗处，腕慢慢垂着。
lines.en: I hang in the dark with arms drooping.

lines.zh: 冰水太冷，我把腕收成一团。
lines.en: The water is freezing; I ball my arms up.

lines.zh: 一只小鱼在我腕间打转。
lines.en: A small fish circles among my arms.

lines.zh: 我眨眼似的收缩了一下身体。
lines.en: I pulse once, like a slow blink.
A whale's shadow passes overhead.
My skin pales by degrees.
I wait for something to swim within reach.
The floor's blackness has no edge.
My beak grinds softly among my arms.
Ice grit sifts down from above.
I rotate slowly, watching every side.

lines.zh: 吸盘一个个松开又咬住水。
lines.en: My suckers release and grip the water.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，任冷水托着。
lines.en: I stay motionless, held by cold water.
That patch of cold light is far off.

lines.zh: 你很小的一个，站得笔直。
lines.en: You are small, standing very straight.

lines.zh: 你的灯照到我的腕上了。
lines.en: Your lamp finds one of my arms.
Smaller than a shark, larger than a fish.
I lower one arm to test you.
You back away; I shift after you.
I spread my arms above your head.
Through the water your pulse beats like a drum.

lines.zh: 你手里的长东西是什么？
lines.en: What is that long thing in your hand?

lines.zh: 我绕着你慢慢转过半圈。
lines.en: I turn a slow half circle around you.

lines.zh: 你的气泡往上跑，我盯着。
lines.en: Your bubbles rise and I watch them.

lines.zh: 一根尖东西扎进我的外套膜。
lines.en: Something sharp pierces my mantle.
Blood thins into the freezing water.

lines.zh: 我一缩身，喷出一大团墨。
lines.en: I contract and blast out a cloud of ink.
The wound is deep; I swim crooked.
Whoever touched me, I will wrap them.
One of my arms is down to half.

lines.zh: 冷水灌进伤口，疼得发木。
lines.en: Cold water floods the wound and numbs it.
I sink behind the reef to hide.
I still have strength — do not leave yet.
I write this grudge in ink.

lines.zh: 那块肉在水里散出味道。
lines.en: That meat leaks its smell into the water.
You raise the fish; I can reach it.
I extend one arm, very slowly.
Are you feeding me, or fishing for me?
The smell is thick enough; I come closer.
My suckers catch on your net.
Throw another piece; I am not full.
That crab is moving; I want it.
My beak has already opened.
I fear you not — only a thin bait.
My whole body slams into the rock wall.
Your boat's hull scrapes across my back.

lines.zh: 我撞散了鱼群，水一片乱。
lines.en: I scatter the school; the water churns.
My arm tangles around the coral.

lines.zh: 冰块撞过来，我顶了回去。
lines.en: An ice block hits; I push it back.
A whale's tail sends me spinning.

lines.zh: 我的外套膜撞瘪了一角。
lines.en: One corner of my mantle dents.

lines.zh: 有东西从我下面顶上来。
lines.en: Something rams me from below.
I collide with another large shadow.
I churn the water like a boiling pot.
Her body is much longer than mine.

lines.zh: 我们把腕交错着缠在一起。
lines.en: We tangle our arms together.

lines.zh: 我喷了一点墨表示亲近。
lines.en: I release a little ink to show I mean well.
She sinks after me, unhurried.
Two vast shadows overlap on the floor.

lines.zh: 我们在冰下找到一处静水。
lines.en: We find still water beneath the ice.
I touch her eye with an arm tip.
She turns; I yield her the passage.
This trench is wide enough for us.
Her arm shadows vanish beneath the ice.

lines.zh: 有块东西沉下来，我卷住它。
lines.en: Something sinks; I coil an arm around it.
I stuff that meat under my beak.
An ink sac bursts and the water blackens.

lines.zh: 我拖着一段触须往回游。
lines.en: I drag a strip of tentacle back with me.
A hard shell sticks between my arms.
I try the stone; my beak cannot.

lines.zh: 掉下来的东西全归我了。
lines.en: Everything that falls is mine.

lines.zh: 我把猎物藏在岩缝深处。
lines.en: I hide my catch deep in a rock cleft.
An old bone twirls in my grasp.

lines.zh: 腕一松，那东西落回沟底。
lines.en: My arm slackens and it drops to the floor.

lines.zh: 一头中型的鱼游进了我的水域。
lines.en: A medium fish wanders into my water.
I smell blood and soft flesh.

lines.zh: 那条鲨鱼太远，这条刚好。
lines.en: That shark is too far; this one is right.
Something flounders beneath the ice.

lines.zh: 一只大蟹在礁上撬贝壳。
lines.en: A big crab pries shells on the reef.
My eye locks onto it in the dark.
That whale is small and wounded.
I have chosen that one.

lines.zh: 水动了一下，我知道有东西。
lines.en: The water stirs; something is there.
Prey approaches along the trench wall.

lines.zh: 我把腕收到身侧，慢慢降。
lines.en: I tuck my arms in and sink slowly.

lines.zh: 它还没发现上面这片黑。
lines.en: It has not noticed the dark above it.

lines.zh: 我转到它下游，堵住退路。
lines.en: I shift downstream to cut its retreat.
Close enough now; I hold still.
It looks up; I flare my arms wide.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸慢得几乎听不见。
lines.en: My breathing slows until it is silent.

lines.zh: 我数着它的心跳等时机。
lines.en: I count its heartbeats and wait.
My shadow covers it inch by inch.
It dives for the ice crack; I must hurry.

lines.zh: 我已经闻到它鳃里的味道。
lines.en: I can smell the breath in its gills.

lines.zh: 我的腕一下缠住它的身。
lines.en: One arm whips around its body.

lines.zh: 喙咬下去，骨头响了一声。
lines.en: My beak bites; a bone cracks.
Suckers clamp tight to its hide.
I slam it against the reef.
It gnaws my arm; I only tighten.
I spray ink straight into its face.
Two arms pull it apart.
Its struggles grow weaker.
Blood parts the cold water around us.
I drag the rest back to my den.

lines.zh: 我从沟底的黑水里睁眼。
lines.en: I open my eyes in the trench's black water.

lines.zh: 这片沟是新地方，我先量了量。
lines.en: This trench is new; I measure it first.

lines.zh: 冰在上方结着，我不在乎。
lines.en: Ice crusts above; I do not mind.
I claim this stretch of channel alone.

lines.zh: 水里的回声告诉我有多深。
lines.en: The echoes tell me how deep it goes.

lines.zh: 我伸开腕，碰到两边的岩。
lines.en: Arms spread, I touch rock on both sides.
A school of fish scatters at my arrival.

lines.zh: 我的身体还带着深水的水压。
lines.en: My body still carries the deep's pressure.

lines.zh: 我把喙张开，试了试这水。
lines.en: I open my beak and taste the water.

lines.zh: 深水的声音很闷，我听着。
lines.en: The deep sounds muffled; I listen.

lines.zh: 热水烫进我的腕缝，我缩紧。
lines.en: Hot water sears between my arms; I curl tight.

lines.zh: 我从冰架上摔落，腕全散开。
lines.en: I fall from the ice shelf, arms splayed.
In air my gills collapse entirely.

lines.zh: 炸浪把我掀翻，墨都喷不出。
lines.en: The blast flips me; I cannot even ink.

lines.zh: 一根鱼叉钉在我的背上。
lines.en: A harpoon pins me through the back.

lines.zh: 蓝光顺着我的腕爬进身体。
lines.en: Blue light crawls up my arms.

lines.zh: 沟里空了，连小虾都没有。
lines.en: The trench is empty; not even shrimp.

lines.zh: 雷击穿水，我的腕全僵了。
lines.en: Lightning pierces the water and stiffens my arms.

lines.zh: 我往外掉，腕抓不住任何东西。
lines.en: I fall, and my arms catch nothing.
